newsitem.title: USA: VSI Holdings says finalizing merger plan.
newsitem.headline: VSI Holdings says finalizing merger plan.

text.p: VSI Holdings said Friday it was finalizing plans to merge with privately-held Vispac Integrated Logistics.
VSI did not disclose terms of the plan, but said the merger would take the form of a stock swap and would be completed by July 1, subject to approval by the companies' boards of directors.
For the fiscal year ended September 30, Vispac had revenues of $16,575,000, VSI said in a statement.
VSI manufactures animatronic figures and operates a retailer of women's apparel.
